scope_of_deliverables.quote: This review will enable BCI, as part of its ISEAL five-year review of capacity strengthening, to decide what to retain, adapt, or redesign in the training cascade model — recognising that the answer may differ by country — and how the Behaviour Change Wheel or similar behaviour change approach should be integrated.
scope_of_deliverables.value: A consultant will review BCI's training cascade model for delivering capacity strengthening to farmers, benchmarking it against other ISEAL standards, co-designing and running an online survey of Programme Partners across 11 countries (in 9 languages), and conducting webinars and up to two face-to-face consultations to test findings and produce a final report by 18 December 2026.

evaluation_criteria.quote:
Proposals will be evaluated based on the following criteria: 

Technical Evaluation Criteria

• 
Demonstrated understanding of this RFP 
• 
Quality and clarity of the proposed approach and methodology  
• 
Feasibility of the proposed activity plan and timeline, and appropriateness of time allocated to delivering each task 
• 
Relevant professional experience of the proposed consultant(s)  
• 
Quality and relevance of the sample work submitted  

Financial Evaluation Criteria

• 
Quality and clarity of budget provided, and level of detail included 
• 
Alignment of the budget to the activity timeline detailed in the technical proposal 
• 
Value for money  
• 
Adherence to the available budget

pricing_structure.quote: Proposals responding to this Request for Proposals should be a maximum of 5 pages (excluding CVs), and include the following: • Overview of relevant experience • Proposed methodology and timeline • Detailed and transparent budget, in EUROS, including time allocation and day rates
pricing_structure.value: Budget must be detailed and transparent, in EUROS, including time allocation and day rates; proposals max 5 pages excluding CVs and must include overview of relevant experience and proposed methodology and timeline.

vendor_experience_required.quote: Essential At least 5 years' experience evaluating or designing farmer training, extension, or training-of-trainers programmes in smallholder and medium farm agriculture Demonstrated survey design and analysis experience, including working across languages Experience producing practical recommendations for programme improvement (not academic research alone) Optional Familiarity with ISEAL standard systems or comparable experience in one or more BCI direct countries sustainability certification schemes Working knowledge of behaviour change frameworks (COM-B / Behaviour Change Wheel or similar) Experience in one or more BCI direct countries
vendor_experience_required.value: Essential: at least 5 years' experience evaluating or designing farmer training, extension, or training-of-trainers programmes in smallholder and medium farm agriculture; demonstrated survey design and analysis experience including working across languages; experience producing practical recommendations for programme improvement (not academic research alone). Optional: familiarity with ISEAL standard systems or comparable experience in one or more BCI direct countries sustainability certification schemes; working knowledge of behaviour change frameworks (COM-B / Behaviour Change Wheel or similar); experience in one or more BCI direct countries.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: Produce and deliver a presentation to BCI to summarise these items.
